headline: Crypto TVL, DEX volumes and stablecoin data: 13 Nov 2026
summary: Ethereum leads chains by TVL at $39.4bn, followed by Base at $5.47bn and Solana at $4.97bn. Uniswap V3 recorded the highest 24h DEX volume at $1.76bn while Tether generated the top fees at $16.9m. USDT and USDC dominate stablecoins with circulations of $175bn and $69.3bn respectively. Multiple incidents occurred in the prior 14 days and several stablecoins show peg deviations.
